key: I WAS aforetime Manu, I was Surya: I am the sage Kaksivan, holy singer. Kutsa the son of Arjuni I master. I am the sapient Usana behold me.
s: Before the hymn praises the Falcon who brought Soma, three verses speak in the first person; Sāyaṇa, on 4.26.1, hears in them Vāmadeva, still in the womb and knowing the truth, speak as the self of all and bid hearers know their own nature so.
src: Sāyaṇa, Vedārthaprakāśa on Rig Veda 4.26.1, sa.wikisource (printed edition not named), revision 209120 (2019)

opened.locator: commentary on 4.26.1, and the hymn introduction

evidence.words: इदमादिमन्त्रत्रयेण गर्भे वसन् वामदेवः उत्पन्नतत्त्वज्ञानः सन् सार्वात्म्यं स्वानुभवं मन्वादिरूपेण प्रदर्शयन्नाह । … परमार्थदृष्ट्या कृत्स्नमप्यहमेवास्मीत्यर्थः । हे जनाः मा मां सर्वात्मकं पश्यत । यूयमप्येवमेव स्वस्वरूपमनुभवतेत्युक्तं भवति
evidence.gloss: With this and the next two mantras Vāmadeva, dwelling in the womb, knowledge of the real having arisen in him, speaks, showing in the forms of Manu and the rest his own experience of being the self of all. … The meaning is: seen with the eye of the highest truth, I am all of it. O people, see me as the self of all. What is said is: you too, in just this way, experience your own nature.
evidence.licence: public domain text; transcription CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikisource)

reason: The problem holds: “hears first Vāmadeva” reads as if a second speaker follows. Sāyaṇa says that in this and the next two mantras (idam ādimantratrayeṇa) Vāmadeva, dwelling in the womb with knowledge of the real arisen (garbhe vasan … utpannatattvajñānaḥ), declares his being the self of all, and bids the people experience their own nature so (yūyam apy evam eva svasvarūpam anubhavata). Corrected to the wording the fix gives; the context clause is trimmed (“praises the Falcon who brought Soma”, which day.js 4.26.4 to 7 bear out) to hold the 45-word cap. Evidence re-cut verbatim from packet.js veda 43 --verse 4.26.1.
